ai.settings_lead: A clinical assistant that summarises visits, offers a second opinion and checks prescriptions. It is off until you switch it on.
ai.platform_off_text: The AI assistant is currently switched off for DocBook. These settings will become available when it is switched on.
ai.status_sub: Requests sent by your clinic this month.
ai.usage_help: Each user can send up to {n} requests per hour. Failed requests do not count toward the monthly limit.
ai.optin_sub: Read the data-processing notice before switching it on.
ai.enable: Turn on the AI assistant for this clinic
ai.enable_help: Allowed staff will see an "AI assistant" panel on the visit page.
ai.notice_sent: When a doctor asks the assistant, de-identified clinical text from that visit (age, sex, vital signs, the SOAP note, diagnosis, allergies, chronic conditions and prescription items) is sent to Anthropic for processing by Claude.
ai.notice_not_sent: Names, phone numbers, national ID numbers, addresses, the exact date of birth and the names of the clinic and doctors are never sent. Phone numbers, e-mail addresses and links are removed from free text.
ai.notice_storage: The doctor sees exactly what will be sent before sending. The answer is saved with the visit; the request is logged without clinical text.
ai.notice_judgement: Answers are suggestions only. Clinical judgement remains the doctor's responsibility; the assistant is not a medical device.
ai.acknowledge: I have read the notice and agree that de-identified clinical text is sent to Anthropic for processing.
ai.roles_sub: Only roles with access to clinical notes can be chosen.
ai.role_no_clinical: This role cannot view clinical notes.
ai.recent_sub: Who asked, when and for what — clinical text is not shown here.
ai.disclaimer: Suggestions only — clinical judgement remains the doctor's responsibility. Not a medical device.
ai.needs_js: The AI assistant needs JavaScript. Turn it on in your browser to use it.

kind_help.summary: A concise structured summary of the saved note, vital signs and prescription — for the patient file or a referral letter.
kind_help.second_opinion: Differential diagnoses with reasoning, red flags, investigations to consider and questions to ask.
kind_help.rx_check: Interactions, dose concerns and cautions against the patient's allergies and chronic conditions.

ai.preview_help: This exact de-identified text is sent. It uses the saved note — save your changes first.

not_ready.summary: Save the note, vital signs or a prescription first.
not_ready.second_opinion: Save the clinical note first (complaint, findings or diagnosis).
not_ready.rx_check: Save a prescription for this visit first.

js.running_hint: This can take up to a minute.
js.error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
js.added: Added to the note — review it and save the note.

ai_admin.title: AI assistant
ai_admin.lead: Clinical assistant for doctors, powered by Claude (Anthropic). Clinics must opt in separately.
ai_admin.key_unreadable_title: The saved API key cannot be read
ai_admin.key_unreadable: The server's APP_KEY changed since the key was saved. Enter the API key again.
ai_admin.settings_sub: Provider key, model and limits for every clinic.
ai_admin.enable: Turn on the AI assistant platform-wide
ai_admin.enable_help: Clinics then see the option under Settings → AI assistant; nothing is sent until a clinic opts in.
ai_admin.key_saved: Saved {hint}. Leave empty to keep it.
ai_admin.key_help: Create a key in the Claude Console. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
ai_admin.notice_help: Shown to clinics above the built-in notice before they opt in (e.g. your agreement with Anthropic, data region, retention).
ai_admin.test_sub: Sends one tiny request with the saved key and model.
ai_admin.usage_sub: Requests answered (including declined and incomplete answers), by clinic.
ai_admin.tokens_help: Token counts are reported by the API and drive the Anthropic bill.

errors_ai.AI_PLATFORM_OFF: The AI assistant is switched off for DocBook.
errors_ai.AI_NOT_CONFIGURED: The AI assistant is not configured yet (no API key).
errors_ai.AI_CLINIC_OFF: The AI assistant is switched off for this clinic. An administrator can switch it on under Settings → AI assistant.
errors_ai.AI_NO_PERMISSION: You do not have access to clinical notes.
errors_ai.AI_ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED: Your role is not allowed to use the AI assistant in this clinic.
errors_ai.AI_MONTHLY_CAP: Your clinic has reached this month's AI request limit.
errors_ai.AI_HOURLY_LIMIT: You have sent many requests in the last hour. Please try again later.
errors_ai.AI_NOTHING_TO_SEND: There is nothing to send yet. Save the note or prescription first.
errors_ai.AI_REFUSED: The assistant declined to answer this request. Please rely on your clinical judgement.
errors_ai.AI_TRUNCATED: The answer was too long and was cut off. Please try again.
errors_ai.AI_BAD_OUTPUT: The assistant returned an answer that could not be read. Please try again.
errors_ai.AI_AUTH: The Anthropic API key was rejected. The platform administrator needs to update it.
errors_ai.AI_FORBIDDEN: The Anthropic account is not allowed to use this model or feature.
errors_ai.AI_MODEL_NOT_FOUND: The configured model was not found or is not available to this account.
errors_ai.AI_PROVIDER_RATE_LIMIT: The AI service is receiving too many requests. Please try again in a minute.
errors_ai.AI_BAD_REQUEST: The AI service rejected the request.
errors_ai.AI_PROVIDER_DOWN: The AI service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors_ai.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI service took too long to answer. Please try again.
errors_ai.AI_NETWORK: Could not reach the AI service.
errors_ai.AI_API_ERROR: The AI service returned an error. Please try again.
